title: Near Downtown - WALK to restaurants, bars & music
description:
Enjoy ample space and a stylish interior in the heart of East Nashville's hip 5 Points neighborhood. Walking distance to an exciting array of restaurants, live music venues, coffee and bars. FREE Parking and free laundry on-site. TVs in all bedrooms + living room. Only 1.9 miles to Downtown Broadway bars. Located on the 1st floor - no stairs to climb! Fully equipped kitchen and high-speed wifi. This condo's new, chic furnishings create a warm and welcoming environment after exploring Music City.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 8 Beds - 1 King Bed, Queen over Queen Bunk Bed, 5 Twin Beds
★ 4 Bedrooms
★ 2 Full size spacious bathrooms
★ Smart TVs in all bedrooms plus the living room
★ Dining table with seating for 6
★ FREE parking
★ Room-darkening shades in all bedrooms
★ Walk to restaurants, live music, coffee shops, bars, a brewery and shopping
★ Located in the Hip & Trendy East Nashville area called 5 Points 
★ Only 1.9 miles to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Washer/Dryer onsite and free to use!
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ High-speed internet
★ Drip coffee machine + filters and coffee provided 
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Located on the 2nd floor - please note you'll need to use stairs to get to this condo
★ Walking distance to Butcher & Bee, Bartaco, WeWork, 5 Points Pizza, Edley’s BBQ, Basement East, Smith & Lentz Brewery and so much more!
★ Two Grocery stores nearby - Publix and Kroger

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: 1 King Bed
Bedroom 2: Queen over Queen Bunk Bed + Twin Bed
Bedroom 3: 2 Twin Beds
Bedroom 4: 2 Twin Beds

BATHROOM: 
Bathroom 1: Full size with stand up shower
Bathroom 2: Full size with stand up shower

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this spacious and comfortable condo. We thoughtfully designed this space with your ease in mind. Although parking is free, you don't need a car for this location. Many exciting things are within walking distance as we are located in one of the most popular areas - 5 Points in East Nashville. The airport is only about 15 minutes away as well. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis readily available. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Music City has to offer! 

Please note you do have to go up stairs to get to this condo as no elevator is available.

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
